product_one_liner.value: Disprz is an AI-powered learning and skilling platform combining LMS, LXP, and AI content authoring to help enterprises build workforce capability at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: The company homepage describes an AI-powered learning and skilling platform combining LMS, LXP, and AI content authoring for enterprise workforce capability.

pricing_page.notes: Disprz has a public page titled Plans and Pricing that presents plan options, so a public pricing page exists.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Disprz’s homepage names Amazon, Axis Bank, Starbucks, and Bharat Petroleum as companies that trust the platform. | named_customers.0: The Disprz homepage names Amazon as a company trusting the platform. | named_customers.1: The Disprz homepage names Axis Bank as a company trusting the platform. | named_customers.2: The Disprz homepage names Starbucks as a company trusting the platform. | named_customers.3: The Disprz homepage names Bharat Petroleum as a company trusting the platform.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists Disprz’s company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official page and LinkedIn profile identify the North America/company-profile headquarters as West Orange, New Jersey; the company separately labels Chennai as its corporate and technology HQ. | hq_country: The official about page lists a North America HQ in West Orange, New Jersey, and LinkedIn explicitly identifies West Orange, New Jersey as the company headquarters. Disprz also lists a corporate/technology HQ in Chennai, so this selects the explicitly identified North America/company-profile headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile identifies Disprz as founded in 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index excerpts show learning-content strategy, learning analytics, soft-skills training, and technical-training guide content. They are educational/marketing topics rather than multiple engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Disprz provides a public developer portal and an API documentation catalog listing multiple APIs with descriptions.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers page lists an AI Content Operations Intern role as open; AI appears in the role title.

model_provider.notes: Microsoft’s Disprz profile says the product uses Azure OpenAI for personalization and advanced learning models.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Disprz’s Trust Vault names ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II, and identifies GDPR as a privacy framework; all three are among the allowed named items. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Vault names ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Vault names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Vault names GDPR as a privacy framework.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest identified round is explicitly described as Series C in the August 2023 announcement. | funding_date: The company-provided funding announcement dates the Series C to August 7, 2023; a funding profile also identifies that August 2023 Series C as the latest round. | funding_amount_usd: The August 2023 company-provided announcement states that Disprz secured US$30 million in its Series C round.

raised_18mo.notes: The identified latest funding round is the $30 million Series C dated August 2023, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live job-board listing shows an open Business Development Representative role with an Apply Now link and a posting age of three days.

launched_6mo.notes: A September 28, 2026 announcement says Disprz unveiled its Autonomous Enablement OS, within the six-month window ending November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Disprz business-operations job post says the role owns HubSpot end to end and names HubSpot and Avoma among the GTM/operational stack. | crm_stack_signal.0: A Disprz job post says it owns and administers HubSpot as its CRM. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job post lists Avoma in the GTM and operational technology stack.
